purpose: Teach: 盛り込ん/伺う/留保/派生/量産/保留/激減/差し上げ

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 防犯計画、住民の声を、盛り込んで、立てております、最新版です。
lines.en: Our crime prevention plan incorporates resident feedback in the latest version.
lines.style: Measured official tone. Even pacing. Opens with quiet authority. Informative without urgency. The confidence of someone delivering prepared briefing material.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察様、当社に、伺うご予定の日、決まりましたら、教えてください。
lines.en: Yes. Please let us know once you've decided on a date for the police visit.
lines.style: Attentive, slightly formal. Respectful uptake — receiving information with readiness. Calm, steady delivery. No edge; just reliable engagement.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 今回の捜査、一部、留保している情報、開示できる時期、近づいております。
lines.en: We're approaching the point where we can release some of the information we've been holding back on this investigation.
lines.style: Even, procedural tone. Slight deliberation before key terms like 'release.' Professional distance maintained throughout. Informative, not conversational.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。事件から派生した、関連事件、御社で、続出しております。
lines.en: Yes. We've seen related incidents stemming from the original case emerge on your end.
lines.style: Brief, factual update. Quiet acknowledgment of complexity. Not rushed, but economical with words. The tone of someone reporting without judgment.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 防犯機器、量産化が進み、家庭にも、普及しております、近年。
lines.en: Crime prevention equipment has been advancing in mass production and spreading into homes in recent years.
lines.style: Steady informational delivery. Slight emphasis on 'advancing' — showing progress. Thoughtful pacing. The tone of sharing relevant context, not lecturing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。被害届、一部、保留にされている案件、ございますね、複雑な背景で。
lines.en: Yes. Some damage claims remain on hold due to their complex background.
lines.style: Calm recognition of complication. No defensiveness. Measured acknowledgment that some things take time to resolve. Steady, professional clarity.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 地域犯罪、激減傾向にあります、皆様のご協力、賜っております、感謝です。
lines.en: Local crime has shown a sharp downward trend thanks to everyone's cooperation. We're grateful.
lines.style: Sincere formal gratitude. Warm beneath the procedural tone. Slight emphasis on 'grateful' — genuine acknowledgment. Professional but not distant.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察への感謝状、社長から、差し上げる予定です、来月。
lines.en: Yes. Our company president plans to send a letter of thanks to the police department next month.
lines.style: Formal closing statement. Clear, straightforward. Slight formality in 'company president' — respectful distance maintained. Warm undertone beneath procedure.
